messages:
maya: Heads-up — canary rollout for the new ingress payload heuristics starts today. We'll soft-split mixed-dim batches unless clients opt out with X-Embed-Prefer=compact.

devon: quick q — how do we decide "soft-split" vs "pass-through"? threshold?

maya: heuristic: if total_bytes > 512KB AND >1 dimension variance (i.e., mixed lengths) then split into chunks <= 256KB preserving order. Otherwise pass-through. Also prefer preserving original indexing in response.

alex: we should emit an explicit telemetry event for every request: `embed.split_decision` with tags {decision:{pass,soft_split,hard_reject}, original_bytes, chunks}`. console UX can surface last decision per tenant.

sam: how does this interact with quotas? if we split a single request into N chunks does it count as N units? need a consistent conversion so billing/quotas match.

maya: agreed — propose we estimate units via `x-embed-units-estimate` header returned by the preflight path; runtime increments quota by estimated units for the original request, not per-chunk. We still emit `embed.units_estimated` metric for reconciliation.

lia: console idea: show an expandable example request with split preview + estimated units and a sample payload snippet so teams can see "why we split". add a toggle to opt into legacy behavior per route.

devon: risky: edge case — streaming clients expect single response stream. If we split, how do we keep the streaming contract?

maya: good catch. streaming clients keep a streamed envelope but we annotate internal chunk boundaries with `chunk_id` in the output envelope. client lib will reassemble by default. We will not change wire format, only add an envelope field: `chunk_id`.

alex: example header for clients who want to opt-out or get metadata:
```
X-Embed-Prefer: compact  # prefer no-split
X-Embed-Units-Estimate: request  # service returns estimate header
```

sam: what about fast-fail for huge payloads? current 1MB returns 413. With soft-split we could accept up to 4MB if splittable, otherwise still 413. Need to update docs and error codes.

maya: plan: allow up to 4MB aggregate only during canary; runtime rejects >1MB when not splittable. We'll add `429` path for rate/units issues and keep `413` for unsplittable oversize. Add a warning banner in console for canary customers.

alex: telemetry counters to add: `embed.split_count`, `embed.split_latency_ms`, `embed.unsplittable_oversize` + histogram of chunk sizes. Also log sample original shape (sparse) for debugging but sample only to avoid PII.

lia: UX ask — add a per-route toggle in rollouts page: "Enable payload soft-splitting" with a link to sample requests and a checkbox to show estimated cost delta.

console-bot: Deploy started: canary group=10% -> eng-platform-canary-2025-03-19. Rollout ETA 15m.

devon: will add reassembly helpers to client-sdk and update streaming glue. I can take telemetry hooks if someone documents the tags.

maya: thanks team. action items: devon=client lib + streaming, alex=telemetry + metrics names, lia=console toggle + examples, sam=quota semantics doc, maya=docs + rollout note. Will follow up with a short changelog PR. :shipit:
